youtube.title: Found Drifting. Nobody on Board. | The Mary Celeste
youtube.description:
December 4, 1872: the Dei Gratia found the Mary Celeste drifting in the Atlantic, seaworthy and empty. Ten people, including the captain's wife and two-year-old daughter, were gone. The cargo of 1,701 barrels of alcohol was nearly untouched.

📂 Case File #007: The Mary Celeste

Sources: Gibraltar salvage hearing (1873); overview: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mary_Celeste
Images: 1861 painting of the ship as 'Amazon', portraits, public domain.
Narration voice: AI.
